name: The Cocktail Lab
overview: Unleash your inner bartender with host Joe Gitter in The Cocktail Lab! Learn pro secrets you can use at home—from the chemistry of ingredients to the science of ice, dilution, and perfect ratios. Learn how to make the perfect martinis, Manhattans, highballs, sours, tropical drinks, and zero-proof favorites—plus episodes on how to properly stir, how to shake, and how to craft big-batch cocktails. Cheers!
